## Due date

**Due:** Friday, September 4, 2026, at 11:59 PM Chicago Time

## Assignment

Complete Exercises 1.3.15, 1.2.38, and 1.3.2 in Howard Anton,
*Elementary Linear Algebra: Applications Version*, 12th edition.

## Submission

Submit your work through
[Assignment 1 in Canvas]({{< meta canvas.assignment_1 >}}).

Follow the submission requirements on the
[Assignments](../pages/assignments.qmd) page. Your work should include enough
explanation and supporting calculations or code for another reader to
reproduce and understand your results.
